lines.text: Boaz sits at the gate with ten elders and tells the nearer kinsman-redeemer that Naomi is selling Elimelech's land.
The nearer kinsman-redeemer cannot redeem the land because it would jeopardize his inheritance, so he removes his sandal and tells Boaz to buy it.
Boaz tells the elders and all the people he has acquired Ruth as his wife, and they wish her to be like Rachel and Sarah.
Boaz takes Ruth as his wife, the LORD enables her to conceive, and she gives birth to a son.
The neighbor women name the baby Obed, who becomes the father of Jesse, the father of Solomon.
